subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Jack met with a/an _____ (deadly) accident.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3'** i.e. **'Fatal'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is 3) **"fatal".**
 
• The word** "deadly"** means something that is capable of causing death. In the sentence, it is used to describe the severity of the accident.
 
• The word **"fatal"** is a synonym of "deadly" and it also means causing death.(घातक)
 
• Hence, it is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Fatal'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's look at the meanings of all the words:
 
 
• **Vital -** In English, "vital" means absolutely necessary or important; essential.(आवश्यक)
 
• **Deaden -** In English, "deaden" means make less strong or intense. (कमजोर करना)
 
• **Explicit -** In English, "explicit" means stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt.(स्पष्ट)
